warning.titlePre: Jaguar S-Type 3.0 V6 Timing Chain Tensioner Failure
paragraphs: If your S-Type 3.0 V6 has the AJ-V6 engine (all models from 1999–2008), timing chain tensioner failure is a documented pattern on this engine. We replace timing chain, tensioners, and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V6 rebuild.
